fields.game/data/audio_cues.json:door_knock: Cue id presented dynamically: AudioPolicy looks every cue up by the id its caller passes (cues[cue_id]), and DoorProp presents interaction.door_knock from a const. Same read shape as every other cue id, which predate the baseline.
